messages:
mari (Software Eng): Hey people-ops — quick heads up: I'm relocating to Madrid, Spain and my move date is 2025-05-15. A few quick Qs: 1) does the WFH stipend keep paying when I change country? 2) will we need to move payroll to Spain and if so when is the cutoff? 3) any tax nexus risk for my team?

jamie (People Ops): congrats, mari! short answers: 1) stipend can continue but amounts/rules change by country, usually prorated the month you move. 2) yes, typically payroll switches to local provider for tax/benefits; we need paperwork before cutoff. 3) possibly — legal needs to evaluate depending on customer activities. can you fill the Location Change form today? link: https://hr.redwood.example/loc-change

mari (Software Eng): thanks — I'm doing the form now. what do you mean by "amounts change by country"? is there a euro amount instead of USD?

jamie (People Ops): correct — we have country bands. Spain falls in the EMEA band; WFH baseline for US is $60/mo, EMEA band is €75/mo. we convert and pay in local currency where payroll supports it. proration: we pro-rate by calendar days for the first/last month. e.g. code block: 
```
prorated = round(band_amount * days_remaining_in_month / total_days_in_month, 2)
```

antonio (Eng): question from infra — does the location change require us to move any infra or data access? could trigger data residency rules.

jamie (People Ops): good flag. if you're accessing EU customer data from Spain we need to confirm data residency controls. I'll loop in Compliance if necessary.

kevin (Finance): tagging @mari — payroll note: if your effective local payroll start is 2025-05-15, final US payroll will be the pay run covering up to 2025-05-14. we need completed tax & bank forms + identity docs by 2025-04-30 to hit that timeline. benefits: medical enrollment may require an EU plan enrollment window — that can be handled but sometimes has a 30-day processing lead time. i'll DM the checklist.

mari (Software Eng): if forms are late what happens?

kevin (Finance): if late, we may have to extend US payroll for an extra month or do a manual split-pay, both are messy. please aim for the 4/30 cutoff.

legal (Legal): quick note on tax nexus: one headcount in Spain doesn't automatically create nexus by itself, but if the role contracts with customers, signs POs, or has a physical office it increases risk. if you expect to do sales/contracting activities, please list them in the Location Change form. Legal will do a preliminary assessment and advise on registration needs.

mari (Software Eng): no client-facing contracting for me, mostly platform eng. added that to the form.

payroll-bot: Location Change form received: LCF-4321 for mari (submitted 2025-03-18). Next step: People Ops review.

jamie (People Ops): received — thanks. action items: mari to upload passport + NIE/visa once available, mari to confirm final move date in the form, kevin to prepare payroll cutoff checklist, legal to run nexus screen. i'll book a 30-min cross-functional sync next week. anyone else? :wave:

antonio (Eng): all good from my side for now. thanks! :thumbsup:

mari (Software Eng): huge thanks team — appreciate the quick responses. I'll upload docs today and reply in-thread if anything pops up.
